newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to issue 150-200 mln mark Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to issue 150-200 mln mark Eurobond.

text.p: Turkey's Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller said on Monday the government would issue Eurobonds worth 150 to 200 million marks on demand from German capital markets.
"After demand from German capital markets, a further issue of 150 to 200 million marks of bonds will be realised," Ciller told reporters.
She did not say when the issue would be launched but said the scheme would be "in the days to come".
Turkey set 500 million mark four-year Eurobond last month through Commerzbank.
Banking sources said most of the bonds were marketed in Germany.
